note: The upload size rule, shared by web lib/upload-limits.ts, RN config/uploadLimits.ts and Flutter config/upload_limits.dart. Bytes are the picked file's size; a mime is read by its base type; an unknown mime is judged as an image; an unknown size passes (the server judges it at its own cap).
hint: PDF, JPG, PNG · PDF max 15 MB, images max 5 MB

cases.name: an image at the cap passes
an image one byte over is refused
a PDF at the cap passes
a PDF one byte over is refused
a PDF over the image cap still passes: the image cap does not apply to it
a mime with parameters is read by its base type
an unknown mime is judged as an image
